stemMarkdown: The average age of a team of 13 members is 20 years. If the captain is 38 years old, what is the average age (in years) of the remaining members? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total age $= 13 \times 20 = 260$. Excluding the captain leaves $260 - 38 = 222$ years across $12$ members, so the average is $\dfrac{222}{12} = 18.5$.
